title: First Sky Bill
content:
Your first Sky broadband bill is delayed with 2 weeks normally. Your broadband may start on any day of the month, but the first payment is about 14 days afterwards. You still pay for a full month, and your second bill is 1 month after the broadband started or about 16 days after your first bill, your third bill and so on are 1 month after the previous bill.

Example:
Broadband start - First bill after 14 days - Second bill after 16 days - Third bill after a month

The same applies to the Sky Q television if you have a direct debit set up.

The Streaming and Glass TV billing is different.
The first bill is within 3 days of your TV starting.
The second bill is after about 27 days of the first bill.
The third bill is a month from the second bill.

Example:
The TV starts - First bill within 3 days - Second bill in 27 days - Third bill a month from the second one

title: How To Fix a Freezing Sky Puck or Glass TV
content:
The puck or Glass TV is freezing or shows a message like Technical Fault, No WiFi, This program is unavailable

1. Unplug your router, boosters and puck and plug them back in
2. Reset your router by holding the reset button for 30 sec, if there is no reset button hold the WPS button for 30 sec
3. Move your router and boosters at least a meter of the floor to avoid the static
4. Keep the space 15 inches around the router and boosters empty
5. After the lights on the router return to normal If you see get connected or network settings or settings on the screen, press that, go to network - status - reset - connect to WiFi using password or WPS, connect using a cable.
6. Changed the picture settings by pressing on your Sky remote home - go down to settings - picture and sound - picture - default streaming format must be set to HD not auto

title: How to Fix a Sky Stream Puck Freezing
content:
1. Move the puck off the floor
2. Move the puck 30 inches
3. Move your router off the floor
4. Move your router 30 inches
5. Hold the reset button on the router for 30 sec, if there is no reset button hold the WPS button
6. Moved your booster off the floor
7. Unplug your booster
8. Call Sky UK 03442 411 411

title: How to fix WiFi dropping
content:
1. Move your router off the floor
2. Move your router 30 inches
3. Hold the reset button on the router for 30 sec, if there is no reset button hold the WPS button
4. Unplug your booster
5. Call Sky UK 03442 411 411

title: How to Setup Your Full Fiber Broadband and Landline
content:
1. You must find the Openreach ONT fiber box on the wall. Normally it's next to the front door.
2. Connect the white ethernet cable(can be black with yellow ends but not purple) to the WAN yellow port 4 on the Sky router and the ONT Openreach box on the wall.
3. Plug in your router.
4. There must be 3 green lights on the ONT.

title: No Broadband / No Wi-Fi / Slow Speed Fiber Only
content:
These instructions are only for the Sky Full Fiber Broadband

1. Check the lights on the router
- Max hub - must be solid white light, sometimes bluish white
if flashing green - no connection to the Openreach ONT on the wall or router fault
if off - no power to the router or router fault

Max hub setup:
- there must be a white sky provided ethernet cable into yellow port 4(WAN) on the Max Router and LAN on the Openreach ONT behind the router, if you have PORT instead of LAN make sure you use PORT1 or PORT2 of the ONT
- the ethernet cable must be at least cat 5E if you do not use the Sky provided cable, Sky does not guarantee the service if you do not use their cables, engineers from Sky or Openreach often put a grey third party cable but that is not advised by Sky
- Swap the ends of the ethernet cable if the light on the router is not solid white or you have slow speeds to the router

Slow speeds:
The router must be at least 1m(3 feet off the floor)
There must be nothing 15 inches around the Max router
It's good to not keep it in a cupboard or shelf if possible
A window cell is not always good, but works in most cases

Swap the ends of the ethernet cable if the light on the router is not solid white or you have slow speeds to the router

2. Check the lights on the Openreach ONT on the wall behind the router 
- Power light - must be solid green, takes 2 min if just started the ONT
- PON light - must be solid green, takes 2 min if you just started the ONT
- LOS light - must be off, takes 2 min if you just started the ONT
- LAN light - flashing green, takes 2 min if you just started the ONT
- Alarm - no important, used for the reserve battery supply for the ONT
- Other lights
if you have PORT instead of LAN it must be flashing green
if you have PORT1, PORT2, PORT3, PORT4 make sure you are using the correct one, normally PORT1 or PORT2

Setup instructions:
https://www.sky.com/help/articles/set-up-hub-which-sky-hub-do-you-have

3. Call Sky ALWAYS explain what you have done so they do not ask you to repeat it
03442411411 - (08:00am-09:00pm) Technical Support & Billing

title: NOW (formerly NOW TV) and Sky
content: NOW (formerly NOW TV) and Sky are officially part of the same company group. However, they operate as separate service providers with separate products and accounts, similar to BT and EE.

title: Premier Sports on Sky
content:
You can watch Premier Sports on Sky Glass by going to the application found under apps and inputs on your Glass TV.

Press home on your Sky remote - go down until you see Apps and Inputs - Go across to the Premier Sports App - Sign in or Sign up - Select your subscription and start watching. Can take 4 hours for the app to start working.

If you're a Sky Q customer, Premier Sports is available as linear TV channels through the TV guide rather than via the Stream/Glass app. You will need the viewing card number from your Sky Q main box when signing up for Premier Sports on their website.
https://www.premiersports.com/

title: Sky Yearly Price Increase
content:
With all Sky TV, broadband and mobile contracts prices may increase during your mining term(the Talk is also included into the yearly price increase).

While the increase happens mostly in April, sometimes it can be later.

The prices do not go up for all packages, but you may have multiple packages increase at the same time, making the bill higher. For example the Sports go up with 4 pound, the normal TV goes up with 4 pounds and some other packages as well, leading to a total price increase of more then 10 pounds.
